title: Support org: headcount review
known: The user is Sam Owner of Larkspur (shown as "You").
lines: Sam Owner (You): Thanks both. Quick one on Juniper, the efficiency list. The names we just moved to Platinum are also on Juniper. Are we keeping them or not?
Grace Holm: Right, that's what confused me too.
Raj Patel: So the answer is, we have four TAMs. There's nobody in the TAM group we should keep.
Raj Patel: That's Lena Voss, that's Mark Ruiz, that's Ana Kim, and uh, Paul Stone. Those positions go, a hundred percent.
Raj Patel: When I interview them, none of them can tell me what they do day to day. Half of it is really CSM work, and that's what my Platinum engineers are for.
Raj Patel: Next is Victor Hale. Title is QAD. I've got a call with him Monday, or Tuesday, to walk me through his week. But I don't see value. Cut and dry.
Raj Patel: The three remaining are Mai Tran, Bao Le, and Kim Ngo, all in problem management in Manila. Those three I absolutely want to keep.
Raj Patel: They do future issue prevention. They're the fire marshals, not the firefighters.
Sam Owner (You): Is Chris aligned on that?
Raj Patel: He is. And how I positioned it with Chris, regardless, we can't notify anyone before December, because Mai's team are doing all the scaling through peak season.
Raj Patel: So we have a couple of months of runway anyway.
Sam Owner (You): Okay so let's take those three off the list, Grace. We can move them to SRE when there's a spot. Chris has runway.
Grace Holm: Done, I'll take them off.
Raj Patel: The four TAMs plus Victor, plus the two from Dev Mehta's org, those are done deals. Position eliminations.
Sam Owner (You): Then we lift the yellow flag, except for those three.
Raj Patel: Correct.
Raj Patel: Oh and one more thing, we probably shouldn't touch anyone's job title in Workday right now, it could hurt us during the reduction.
Raj Patel: Also, good news, the Platinum team already found about two hundred and fifty thousand in ARR we didn't know we had.
Grace Holm: Love that. Okay, and Raj, I'm out Friday, my daughter's dance competition.
Raj Patel: Have fun.

Don't change job titles in Workday during the reduction
